title: Slack thread: Plugin not loading (#it-helpdesk-triage)
text:
Priya experienced an issue where a plugin silently failed to load on app startup due to a version mismatch. The problem was resolved by updating the plugin to match the current app build.

Full exchange:
[Priya, 9:14 AM] anyone seen a plugin just silently not load on app startup? no error, it's just... not there
[Priya, 9:14 AM] was working fine last week
[Dave, 9:16 AM] yeah happened to me, check the plugin log first -- usually shows a version mismatch
[Priya, 9:19 AM] oh there it is, yep version mismatch against the app build
[Dave, 9:19 AM] update the plugin to match, that should do it
[Priya, 9:24 AM] updated it, loads fine now 🙏

title: Slack thread: Session timeout (#it-helpdesk-triage)
text:
Marcus experienced being repeatedly logged out of a web app every five minutes due to an incorrectly configured short idle timeout setting for his user role, which was resolved by correcting the role's timeout value.

Full exchange:
[Marcus, 2:03 PM] getting logged out of the web app way sooner than it should, like every 5 min
[Marcus, 2:03 PM] even while actively using it
[Renee, 2:05 PM] is it just the app or does it re-prompt for full login (SSO)?
[Marcus, 2:08 PM] just the app, SSO stays logged in
[Renee, 2:09 PM] ok that's app-level then, not SSO. check the app's idle timeout setting for your role/group -- some roles got a shorter value pushed recently
[Marcus, 2:15 PM] yep that was it, my role was on the shorter timeout by mistake. got it corrected

title: Slack thread: Laptop screen blue tint (#it-helpdesk-triage)
text:
Jordan reported a weird blue tint across their laptop display. After verifying the color profile and testing with an external monitor to isolate the issue, Priya identified it as a hardware defect and logged a repair ticket for the laptop panel.

Full exchange:
[Jordan, 10:50 AM] my laptop screen has this weird blue tint across the whole display, colors look off
[Jordan, 10:50 AM] started this morning, nothing changed on my end
[Priya, 10:55 AM] check display color calibration/profile first, sometimes it gets changed accidentally
[Jordan, 11:02 AM] checked, profile looks normal actually
[Priya, 11:03 AM] ok try an external monitor then, if tint doesn't show up there it's the panel not the settings
[Jordan, 11:20 AM] tested on external monitor, totally clean. so it's the panel
[Priya, 11:21 AM] yeah that's a hardware ticket then, panel defect. I'll log it for repair
[Jordan, 11:22 AM] thanks!! 🙏

title: Slack thread: External HDD not mounting (#it-helpdesk-triage)
text:
An external hard drive was showing up in Device Manager with a partition but would not mount because it lacked a drive letter. The issue was resolved by manually assigning a drive letter to the partition in Disk Management.

Full exchange:
[Sam, 3:12 PM] external drive shows up in device manager but doesn't mount, no drive letter or anything
[Sam, 3:12 PM] on and off since yesterday
[Dave, 3:14 PM] check disk management, does it show as unallocated/not initialized, or does it show a partition but just won't assign a letter?
[Sam, 3:19 PM] shows a real partition, just no letter
[Dave, 3:20 PM] ok that's a different branch than the unallocated case then, that one's usually just a manual drive letter assignment in disk management -- right click the partition, add a letter
[Sam, 3:25 PM] did that, mounted right away. thanks!

title: Slack thread: Application crash on exit (#it-helpdesk-triage)
text:
The design app v14.3 was experiencing exit crashes caused by a bundled cloud-sync plugin hanging on shutdown. This was resolved by disabling the plugin via Settings > Plugins > Cloud Sync > disable.

Full exchange:
[Renee, 11:02 AM] getting another one of those exit crashes on the design app, but this looks like the v14.3 thing again
[Priya, 11:04 AM] oh yeah the v14.3 bug, vendor still hasn't patched it as of last week
[Renee, 11:05 AM] is there an actual fix or just the usual disable-autosave workaround from the SOP
[Priya, 11:07 AM] no for v14.3 specifically that doesn't work, autosave isn't the cause this time -- it's actually the new cloud-sync plugin they bundled in that version, it hangs on shutdown
[Priya, 11:07 AM] workaround is to disable the cloud-sync plugin specifically (not autosave), Settings > Plugins > Cloud Sync > disable, then it exits clean
[Renee, 11:15 AM] tried it, works. good find
[Priya, 11:15 AM] yeah this is v14.3-only as far as I've seen, don't think it's worth a full SOP page since the vendor patch should make it moot soon, just flagging here so we remember 🙏
